title: Juniors Pancyprian Competition
text:
Juniors Pancyprian competition is the second competition in the series of competitions used to challenge bright students on the path toward choosing the team that represents Cyprus at the JBMO. It is held in December and is called "Evagoras Pallikaridis". All participants in this contest have been first qualified in Cyprus Juniors Provincial competition. Until 2003 there was no Pancyprian competition for 1st and 2nd grade. As of 2004 every grade has different problems. Afterwards 10 students from every grade are selected.

Total: 3 grades * 10 students = 30 students.

Those students are qualified to move on the Cyprus Juniors Team Selection Tests.
